'''October 1999 Glenside tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in RPG Outpost, Glenside, Pennsylvania on 24 October 1999. [[Kim Caton]] won it. It is known from Kim Caton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d86">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-glenside-pa-10-24-99d86/ glenside-pa-10-24-99], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 25 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-glenside-pa-10-24-99d86/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 October 1999
* '''Site:''' RPG Outpost, Glenside, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Kim Caton]]
